Commentary.Commentary: That's it from us! The ODI series has come to close and India have won convincingly. Australia may have been outclassed, but there are positives for them to take and work on. They're going to have to do it quick too as the T20I series will begin in a few days. It's a different format and they have a fresh chance to bounce back. The first game will take place on 7th October in Ranchi at 1900 local (1330 GMT). Do join us for all the action. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Indian captain, Virat Kohli says he is feeling really good and it was a very convincing series win for them. Adds that they have repeated what they did in Sri Lanka and he is really proud and happy. Further adds that the management is playing a massive role in motivating the players. Feels that they ticked most of the boxes in the series. Also says that Bhuvi and Bumrah were outstanding for them, class apart, and that's been the difference. Has a word of praise for the spinners and terms Hardik Pandya as the biggest positive of the series. On competition within the side, Kohli replies that it's a good headache to have, better to have in-form players than those not up to the mark. Credits the hard work of his boys for all the success.

Man of the Series, Hardik Pandya says life is pretty good. Further says it's good to bat at No.4 and do good in the series. States there is always scope for improvement in everything he does. Adds that he works on his fitness and places a lot of importance on that. Ends by saying the different batting positions aren't what he's used to, so it's a learning experience for him.

Man of the Match, Rohit Sharma says he is fine, just cramps as the weather is hot here. Adds that he keeps it very simple and that has worked for him. Feels that he still has certain areas to work on and he is aware of his strengths and weaknesses. Also adds that it was tough initially and he decided to get his eye in first. Informs it was more about rotating the strike and he kept talking with his partner. Says that he loves playing against Australia as they are very competitive and that brings the best out of him.

Australian captain, Steven Smith says he thinks they were probably 30 runs under par. Adds his openers gave his side a good start but lost wickets in clumps later. Is disappointed with the result and admits there obviously are a lot of things to work on. Thinks his team needs to get the right balance and put consistent performances on the field. Opines India thoroughly deserved to win the series 4-1. Is staunch when he says a lot of his players have played a lot of cricket in India so can't use 'a lack of experience' as an excuse. Feels they just have to be consistent and play well. States they have to keep a positive frame of mind, take the good things from this series and build on that. Further says his team is going to let this go pretty quickly and focus on the T20Is. Ends by saying they want to go home with a trophy.

Australia didn't have the best of days today. A lot more was expected off them, especially after how they performed in the previous game. They threw away yet another start with the bat to end up with an under par score on the board, which was courtesy some quality bowling from the Indian spinner. And then, were toothless with the ball. They lacked inspiration and ultimately succumbed to the Indian onslaught they endured. A day to forget for them. Don't go anywhere, the presentation will be coming up in a bit...

A thumping performance from the Men in Blue. With this victory, they've won the series 4-1 and regained the No.1 spot in ODIs. With a target of 243 in front of them, India started off in the best manner possible. Sharma and Rahane got their team off to a blazing start. A century stand set the tone for the game before Rahane departed after scoring yet another fifty. Rohit (who scored an impressive ton) carried on with his skipper and the duo made a 99-run stand which more or less sealed the game. Jadhav and Pandey came in and added the finishing touches on a stunning chase.

FOUR! There it is, Manish Pandey does it! INDIA WIN BY 7 WICKETS AND 43 BALLS TO SPARE! As comfortable as any win could come for them. Outstanding performance. Pandey drills this full ball past the diving mid on fielder and sends it all he way to the boundary line.

FOUR! In the slot and Manish Pandey takes full advantage. Although, he didn't hit it cleanly, he won't mind. Fuller ball angling in on off, Pandey skews the slog off the inner half and beats the mid-wicket fielder all the way to the boundary line. India just one hit away from victory.
Fraction straighter in line, on middle stump this time. Pandey with a comfortable defensive shot in response.
Keeps it around the off stump line, it's defended down on the track right beside him.
Angling back in on middle and off, Manish moves inside the line and defends it in front of mid-wicket.
Pushed into the covers with the spin and a run is taken.
Flighted ball outside the line of off stump, drilled down to long off for a run.
Darts it quicker on leg, Jadhav misses his tickle and it goes off his pads on the leg side.
Loops it up just outside off, Jadhav presents a tight front foot defensive shot.
Another googly, turning in on middle and leg, Pandey goes deep inside the crease and works it away in front of square leg for a single.
Googly outside off, Pandey covers the line and lets it be.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Stays right behind the line of the ball and guards it with a straight bat.
Length ball angling in from outside off, Jadhav walks across to get close to the ball and defends it in front of point.
Full delivery aiming the base of off stump, Pandey looks to wrist it on the leg side but gets a leading edge which flies towards third man. Easy single taken.
Fuller outside off, Pandey reaches out and pushes it to the man at short cover.
From around the wicket, it's angling in on middle and off, Pandey defends it in front of mid-wicket with a closed face.
Powerplay 3 signalled. 5 fielders allowed outside the ring now. India need 12 runs to win with 10 overs still to go.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! A long hop from Adam Zampa, Jadhav doesn't waste the chance to cash in on it. He camps back and pulls it powerfully over mid-wicket for a one bounce boundary.
Manish Pandey is the next batsman in.

OUT! Kohli is gone looking to finish it off quickly. It's full and loopy around off, Kohli lofts it attempting to clear long off. He, much like Rohit, doesn't get the distance on it. Straight down the throat of Stoinis who takes it well.
FOUR! Shorter from Zampa, Kohli quickly picks the length up. He stays back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Pushed quicker on middle and off, defended by staying right behind the line.
Kedar Jadhav in next.

OUT! A terrific innings comes to an end! He was tired, so he just looked to finish it off as fast as he could. And with not many runs required to win, it wasn't much of a risk to take at this stage. Tossed up on middle and off, Rohit Sharma goes for the slog and lofts it over mid-wicket. Doesn't get the distance on it at all and it's taken comfortably by Coulter-Nile out in the deep. The Indian opener departs on 125, a blazing knock has come to an end.
Adam Zampa back on.
Full and fired well outside off, Rohit drills it hard back down the ground to long off for one. 20 required to win from 66.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Fuller around off, smashed aerially to long off for a single.

SIX! So, so comfortable in playing that. Rohit Sharma makes the big hits look so easy. Shorter on off, he stands tall and muscles it over the long on boundary for half a dozen. He's targeted that area quite a lot today. Superb hitting.
Bit shorter in length on middle and off, Rohit hangs back and defends it back down the track.
Flat and going straight outside off, Kohli opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man for a single.

Not out! Seemed safe to the naked eye as well. Faulkner from around the wicket angles it down the leg side, Kohli looks to tickle it fine and Wade collects the ball in jiffy. Whips the bails off and there's a stumping appeal. It's taken upstairs and replays show that Kohli is fine. In the process, the TV umpire also checked whether there was an edge, but he found nothing. Wide is also signalled as a result.
A stumping appeal against Virat Kohli is referred upstairs by the umpire.
James Faulkner is called back into the attack.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! Half-tracker on the stumps, Kohli swivels and pulls it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Turning away from around off on a fullish length, Sharma gets an edge as he looks to defend. It goes towards short third man as a single is taken.
Darted fuller and flatter outside off, drilled through the covers for one. Kohli wanted the second but Rohit refused. He seems tired. Why wouldn't he be? He's played a long knock in hot conditions.
Flat and short outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Full on middle and off, Kohli scuffs his drive back down the track. Finch misfields which allows the batsmen a single.

SIX! That's gone sailing into the crowd! What a hit. Length ball, he stands tall and muscles the slog down the ground. Clears long on with ease and India march closer to victory with that. Only 40 needed off 78.
Short again, into the body this time, Virat Kohli pulls through square leg for one.
Another powerful pull, but just a single this time. Sharma drags the pull from outside off and picks up a single as the deep mid-wicket fielder cuts it off.

FOUR! He's played that shot a few times before in the innings, has executed it every time to perfection. Back of a length on middle, Sharma moves inside the line and pulls it aerially through backward square leg for a boundary.
A heave across the line. It's on a length so Kohli places it along the ground to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Good length ball outside off, Rohit smacks that hard through to sweeper cover and begins the over with a single.
Plays it with the turn, reaches out to it and plays it to point.
Drags his length back on this occasion, the batsman off his back foot punches it to long on and gets off strike.
Finch bowls it slower through the air again, Rohit kneels to sweep but is early into the shot. Ends up getting hit on the body as the ball rolls behind on the off side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Slower through the air, spinning away from around off, Rohit looks to put bat on ball but fails to connect.
Fuller ball landed outside off, driven through the cover region for a single.

SIX! You wouldn't expect him to get to his 14th ODI hundred in any other way. Sensational knock from Rohit Sharma, it's hit 6th ODI ton against Australia. Back of a length, he picks up the length early and pulls it over mid-wicket. Clears the fence with ease and gets another maximum to his name.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length delivery outside off, kept out off the back foot.

Almost another mix-up! But this time, Rohit makes an early call and shouts 'NO!' to avoid anything like the last game. Back of a length outside off, Sharma looks to pull but gets a bottom edge behind. Kohli takes off, but gets a call from his partner to go back. The skipper has a wry smile on his face.
Dab and run. Gets it in his favourite area, down to third man and takes one.
Full and wide outside off, Kohli drives it hard but finds the man at cover. He'll feel hard done by it, had connected so well.
Nathan Coulter-Nile returns to the attack.
Short and wide outside off, cut away wide of backward point for a single.
Short again, this time Sharma works it down to long on for one.
Short in length and on middle and off, punched to long on for a single.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.
Dropped short on off, Sharma goes back and punches it to long on to get off strike.
Starts off from around the wicket as he tosses it up outside off, Sharma drives it square past point and picks up a double for doing so.
Aaron Finch will have a go with the ball now.
Fired full on the stumps, driven straight back to Cummins.
Outside off on a good length, guided down to third man for a single. With this, Rohit Sharma has completed 6000 runs in ODI cricket.
A superb shot on the punch. Rohit Sharma gets on top of the bounce with a firm punch towards the sweeper. Two runs taken.
Another run in the same region. Dabbed down to third man.
Short delivery outside off, Rohit plays the ramp shot and gets it down to third man. Can't find the fence though as the fielder there cuts the ball off by moving to his left. One run taken.
Back of a length outside off, Virat Kohli with a walk down the track dabs it down to third man for a single.
Drinks break!

SIX! Excellent end to the over! What a shot from Sharma! He comes down the track and launches it over the long on boundary for a biggie. The balance and the composure to play that was superb. India just need 75 runs to win in 108 balls.
Sees it's well outside off, doesn't turn at all and it's dabbed to third man for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. Won't get any run for it though.
Plays for the turn but there is none. Kohli is just beaten past the outside edge as he tries to play at it. That bounced a bit more too. Close one.
Floats it up on the stumps, Kohli brings his beautiful wrists into play and whips it through the mid-wicket area. Big gap out there, so he'll get a couple of runs.
Full and speared outside off, drilled square on the off side for a single.
Another good over from Pat Cummins. Kohli has a push at it to the covers. The ball was outside off and on a tight line, which didn't let Kohli score freely.
Keeps it in the zone around off, tempts Kohli to have a poke at it. The Indian captain does so and almost gets a feather on it. Close call.
Lands it just ahead of a length, on middle and off, Kohli walks a step across and meets it with a defensive shot.
Curling back in on middle and leg, Rohit looks to work it across the line but misses and is hit on the pads. The ball falls on the leg side and a leg bye is taken.
Short of a good length outside off, Rohit throws his bat at this. Only connects with thin air on this occasion.

Length delivery in the channel outside off, Rohit smacks it straight to point. Kohli is halfway down the track, but then turns around and gets back in the crease. Similar to what transpired in the last game, only Kohli could have been on the receiving end this time.
Works it away to the mid-wicket area and that'll be the end of the over.
Flat and short outside off, pushed away on the off side from the back foot.
Tossed up this time, Kohli meets it with a cover drive which goes straight to the fielder.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
Fuller and flatter on the stumps, lofted down to long on for a run.
Moving away a bit from outside off, punched away into the off side for a run.
Travis Head back into the attack.
Good bumper from Cummins to end the over. It's sharp, accurate and well-directed. Kohli has to be alert to it. He does well to duck and evade.
Another punch, through to sweeper cover for a single.
Sits up to him once more, Rohit once again gets top of the bounce but can only find the point fielder with his dab this time.
Shooting off the deck a bit, outside off on a length. Sharma rises and punches it past point for two runs.
Fired in full at over 140 clicks, not giving any room to Rohit Sharma to work with. The batsman can only block by bringing down a straight blade.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, Sharma leans across to get behind the line and defends.
Full outside off, driven to covers to end the over.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Well played! Quicker one outside off, Kohli waits for it, plays it really late and runs it past Wade. Runs hard and as a result, manages to come back for the third.
Looped right up there, drilled by Virat Kohli towards sweeper cover for a couple of easy runs.
Short, flat and slow. Sharma off his back foot punches it to long on and takes one.
Doesn't spin much, it's tossed up on middle, Kohli pushes it to long off for a run.
Not to be! Virat Kohli picks out the gap in the covers and takes a single with a firm punch. Terrific over nonetheless from the Aussie pacer, he's done a terrific job.
Five in a row! Could we be in for a maiden? Excellent stuff so far from Pat Cummins. Keeps it outside off, forces Kohli to touch it. The Indian skipper can only find the man at point.
Make that four. Cummins lands it in the off stump channel, on a good length, Kohli tries to have a poke at it but fails to connect.
Third dot in a row. Kohli with another dab but to point this time.
Close to off, on a good length this time, Kohli opens the face and dabs it straight to short third man.
Instantly attacks the stumps as he bowls it on middle and leg, Kohli gets inside the line and wrists it in front of mid-wicket.
Pat Cummins is back into the attack.
Tossed up on middle and leg, works it against the spin to mid-wicket. India need 101 runs of 24 overs.
FOUR! Goes inside out, takes the aerial route and gets the desired result! Superb shot from Rohit Sharma. Lofts the full ball over covers and beats the sweeper to the fence.
Spinning away from outside off, reaches out to it and pushes it to cover.
A lot of revs on this, pitched outside off, Kohli drives it easily to long off for one.
Full ball outside off, driven to the left of sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Great delivery. Looped up just around off, Virat comes half-forward and defends. Gets an inside edge onto his front pad as he does so.
Outside the line of off stump on a good length, hit straight to the point fielder.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Connects well but is unfortunate to find the fielder. Full and wide, Kohli drives but finds the man stationed at cover.
Short of a length on middle and leg, pulled away along the ground square on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Kohli rises and works it well through mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball close to off, Kohli walks across a step and pushes it on the up to covers.
Good delivery to end the over. Nice shape on it as Zampa floats it up there outside off, Sharma comes ahead and defends.
Bit fullish in length and outside off, pushed into the covers for a single.
Half-volley on middle and leg, driven to long on for a run.
Bit of a misfield from Smith. Kohli pushes it in his direction at short cover. There's uneven bounce due to which the ball goes off his left foot. Results in conceding a single.
Loopy full toss on off, eased to long off to bring Kohli on strike.
FOUR! Shot! Short and wide outside off, begging to be punished and Rohit obliges. He hangs back and cuts it past the diving point fielder to send it across the rope.
Adam Zampa to bowl again.
Extends his arms, reaches out to the full ball outside off and pushes it to the cover fielder.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller in length on middle and off, Kohli meets it with a defensive bat.
Virat Kohli walks in at No.3.

OUT! The on-field decision stays! Finally, a breakthrough for the Australians. But it's come too little too late. Coming back in on middle and leg, Rahane walks across to flick it away. Is caught on the pads and there's a loud appeal. The umpire takes his time and then raises his finger. Ajinkya after speaking to his partner decides to review. Replays show that it's clipping leg and so, he'll have to walk back as it's the umpire's call. Another good knock comes to an end. Partnership of 124 comes to an end. This is also the sixth successive fifty Rahane has failed to convert to a century. An area where he needs to work.
Ajinkya Rahane is given out lbw. He walks up to his partner, has a chat and then signals for the DRS. It looks touch and go, maybe high. Let's see...
FOUR! Superb shot! Tailing back in on middle and leg, Rahane takes a walk down the track and swipes it across the line. Through mid-wicket and it's away to the boundary line.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot on the off side.

Good effort by Pat Cummins! Saves runs for his team. Room there, Rohit cashes in and flays it through point. Cummins from sweeper cover runs to his left to cover a lot of ground and saves it with a good dive. Keeps the batsmen to just two.
Works it off his pads and flicks it on the leg side for a single. With this, Rahane has completed 6000 international runs. The 22nd Indian to do so. A great feat, completely deserved.

Dropped! The look on Faulkner's face says it all. Should have taken that, really. Length ball outside off, Rahane looks to run it to third man but gets a feather behind. Wade can't keep a hold of it as he spills it to his left.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Sits up for Rohit Sharma on a length outside off, he plays it off the outer half behind point and crosses over.
Fullish in length and outside off, lofted to long off. Easy run. No trouble at all.
On a good length and just outside off, with an open-faced bat Rahane dabs it to third man. Single more to the total and that'll be the end of the over.
Length delivery well outside off, it stays a bit low again as Jinx punches it to covers.
Kept a little low as Rohit looked to pull it away. Off the inside edge and on the leg side for a run.
Rahane plays a similar shot. Arches back a bit and steers it towards the third man fielder for one.
Waits for the ball to come to him as he guides it down to third man for a single.
Length delivery around off, dabbed to cover-point.

FOUR! 23rd ODI fifty for Ajinkya Rahane! His 4th consecutive half century, 8th in his last 11 innings. He's in sublime form. What a way to bring it up too! He gets a full ball which he smashes right back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length ball on off stump, hit back down the track.

In the air... But it's fallen safe! Kind of unnecessary, but given how things are going, can understand why he'd want to take those risks. Shortish ball angling in on middle and leg, Rahane comes out of his crease and pulls it over mid-wicket. Luckily for him, it falls well short of the man in the deep. Just a single taken.
Fractionally fuller again, Rahane with a solid front foot defense.
Starts off from around the wicket, it's fired in full and just outside off, Rahane drills it straight back to Faulkner.
James Faulkner returns.
Shortish in length outside off, punched square through point for a couple of runs.
FOUR! There's no stopping him, is there? He's just toying with the Aussie bowlers here. Back of a length, he walks down the track and heaves it over the mid-wicket area for a boundary.
Comes half-forward to this fuller length ball and meets it with a straight bat.
35th ODI fifty for Rohit Sharma! 'The Hitman' continues his assassination of any bowling attack he faces. Receives it on the pads and nudges it in front of square leg for a couple of runs.
Positions himself perfectly behind the line and blocks.
Opens the face of the bat and helps it down to third man for a single.

FOUR! Terrific end to the over for India. Fuller ball outside off, Sharma drives it through the covers for a boundary. All his drives today have been of pure timing rather than power. Been such a treat to watch.

SIX! Rohit Sharma and sixes - still a better love story than Twilight! He gets underneath it and thumps it perfectly. Comes down the track and smokes it over a leaping David Warner at long on for a maximum.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Skips down the wicket and defends it getting close to the pitch.

Oooh... Close! Similar ball, shorter in length but this keeps quite low. Rahane, who initially goes back, does well to adjust and work it across the line. The man at mid-wicket once more does well to dive to his right and save it.
Flat, short and turning in, Rahane plays this across the line but only as far as the mid-wicket fielder.

Drinks are on the field! India are motoring along here far too easily. Australia have kept a defensive field and failed to apply the pressure. Steven Smith needs to take a few risks and get a wicket here, and quick! Otherwise he runs the risk of losing this match quicker than he'd expect.
Comfortable single to end the over. Rahane offers a solid punch extending his arms and finds sweeper cover.
Closer to the off stump this time, it's played back to the bowler.
Short of a length and just outside off, pushed away with soft hands on the off side.

Elegantly done. Sharma with the full face of the bat drives this on the up. Extends his arms a bit as he places it just wide of Finch at mid off. He dives to his left and makes a good stop. Only a single taken.
Just shorter of a full length, bit slower in pace too. Rohit has to check his shot as he pushes it back to the bowler.
Too full and quite straight from Stoinis, Rahane with no trouble at all eases it to long on for a run.
Marcus Stoinis comes back on to bowl.
Gives this a good amount of air, Rohit drives it as soon as the ball pitches. Only finds the cover fielder however.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Full and straight, it's played back to the bowler.
Flighted ball attacking the stumps, driven to long on once again for another run.
Full on the stumps, driven towards the long on fielder to get off strike.

A good effort from Matthew Wade, all in vain though. This one turns and bounces a touch more, lobs off Rahane's pads and goes on the leg side. Wade runs across to his left and dives to take it with one hand, only to realize there was no bat involved.
Short and flat, Ajinkya Rahane has all the time in the world to go back and pull this to deep mid-wicket for one.
Full toss from Adam, knocked to long on for one more.
Full in length this time, pushed towards sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! He's found the gap! Landed short, Rahane waits for the ball to come to him by rocking back. Times the punch all too well and finds the cover boundary.
Quicker one from Zampa, attacks the stumps, Rohit goes back to play is slightly taken by surprise due to the pace. However, he somehow manages to play a checked punch shot to long on and take one.
Floats it up there, seeing the flight Rahane gives the charge. Smacks it aerially to wide long off and takes a single.
Rohit Sharma has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Another one turned on the leg side, this is too easy. One more run.
Works it with the spin and gets it past the mid-wicket fielder for a couple of runs.
Minimal turn from Head, Jinx guards it out by getting right behind the line.
Rahane steps out of his crease, the ball is short and turning. He pulls it along the ground square on the leg side and comes back for the second via some good running.
Flatter and fuller around off, defended with a straight bat.
FOUR! Poor delivery to end the over. Dropped short on middle, Sharma swivels and pulls it through square leg. There is a man out in the deep but he has no chance to stop that.
Loopy and full outside off, drilled through the cover region for a double.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

EDGY FOUR! Feel for the leggie, he's quite unfortunate. Tosses it up nicely on middle and leg and it spins away ever so slightly. Rohit drives but nicks it behind. Goes past Wade and away to the boundary line.

Almost... Almost! Adam Zampa could have had the first wicket in this innings. He darts it full and flat, on middle and leg, Rahane charges out to play at it and it almost goes through. Is lucky he gets it off the inside edge down the leg side. Single added to the scoreboard.
Waits for the ball to come to him and hits it towards backward point for a single.
6 singles in the over. All too easy for this opening Indian pair. Worked to square leg comfortably.
Driven towards the mid off region. One run added to the total.
Looped up just outside off, Rohit with a nice stride forward drives it down to long off for a single.
A little shimmy down the track, worked with the spin past mid-wicket for one.

Turning in on leg, sticks off the surface a bit. Sharma is early into the shot as he pushes it aerially just wide of short mid-wicket. Could have easily handed a simple catch on that occasion. Single taken as the ball rolls down to long on.
Darted full and straight, not turning much, Rahane drives it back past the bowler for a single.
Travis Head to roll his arm over.
Rahane makes use of his feet again, takes it on the full and hits it to long on this time for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Uses his feet well to get to the pitch and knocks it to long off for a single.
Straighter one on off, Rahane sits back and cuts it a bit square on the off side. Right at the fielder though.
Spinning away from the batsman, he presses ahead and keeps it out.
Tossed up leg spinner around off, Rohit just checks his drive and spoons it down to long off. Was in the air for a short while but no mid off in place. So, a single results.
Powerplay 2 signalled. 4 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle. And with that, Adam Zampa is introduced into the bowling attack.
Length ball on off, dabbed in front of point to end the over.
Driven comfortably down the ground, to the long off fielder for one run.
Rohit gives the charge to this fuller length ball, meets it at its pitch but can only tamely push it away.
Steven Smith has a fielder specifically for that. That's good fielding placement. Sharma looks to run it down to third man, but there's a fielder placed inside the ring to cut it off.
Bit fullish, eased to long off to rotate strike.

FOUR! Welcome to the attack, James! Rahane puts the pressure on him immediately. From around the wicket, it's full and outside off, Rahane drives it through the covers and starts the over off with a boundary.
James Faulkner to bowl now.
Length delivery just outside off, Rohit stands tall and knocks it into the covers.
Cutting back in off the surface, flicked to short fine leg.
Plants his front foot forward and defends the full ball with utmost ease.

FOUR! Picked his spot well and executed his shot to perfection. Good awareness shown by Rohit Sharma. Seeing the ball dropped a little short, he moves across his sticks and pulls it along the ground through backward square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Rahane comes down the track and heaves. Doesn't time it well but still gets it away and takes a single.
Short of a good length outside off, punched just wide of mid off. Rahane took off wanting the single but Rohit was ball-watching. He's definitely not pleased with that.
Length delivery in the channel outside off, Sharma plays and misses.

FOUR! All about the timing that shot. The bat presentation, the balance, the head position, all absolutely perfect. Beautiful. Full and wide outside off, Rohit leans into the shot and sweetly drives it through the gap in the cover region for a boundary. No stopping that.
Fine leg comes inside the circle, square leg drops back.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Width offered outside off, Rohit Sharma has a wild hack at this. Hits it really well, but can only find the cover-point fielder.
Length ball keeping a little low, Sharma still has a swipe at this as he plays it across the line. Finds the man positioned at mid-wicket.
Bouncer around off, it isn't that quick which forces Rohit early into the pull shot. He misses and is hit on the right arm. Probably didn't bounce as much either.
Uses the angle well and turns it on the leg side. Did so by bringing his bat around his front pad.
Full and straight, Rohit just checks his drive and chips it for a brief moment. Since mid on is out at the boundary line now, there was no danger in playing that. Single taken by the batsmen.
Comfortably done. Some room to work with and Rahane steers it to third man with an angled blade. One run taken.
Short of a length and it's punched to mid off. No run taken.
Wicket-to-wicket line from Stoinis, pushed back down the track straight to the bowler.
Marginally ahead of a length on middle and off, Sharma with a drive back down the ground towards mid on for a single.
Marcus Stoinis is into the attack.
Kicks off the deck a bit as it's cutting back in from around off, pushed into the off side from deep inside the crease.
On a length again, tight line from Nathan Coulter-Nile, Rahane can only drive it straight back to him.
Just ahead of a good length, in that channel around off, Rahane meets it with the full face of the bat.
Full and attacking the stumps, driven to mid on for nothing.

FOUR! Wonderfully hit! That's a shot from a man oozing with confidence. Length ball, he gets right on top of it and drives it on the up. Through extra cover and away to the fence for a boundary. With this, he has now completed 200 runs in the series.
Dropped on a length, pretty close to the off pole, Rahane defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Two in two for Rohit Sharma! Another full ball, this time Rohit takes the aerial route. Lofts it easily over mid off and ends the over in style.
FOUR! Superb way to get off the mark! Cummins keeps it full once more and this time Rohit doesn't miss out. He drives it crisply through mid off and picks up a boundary.

That could have been out! Close call for Rohit. Fuller length ball around off, right in the slot so Sharma goes for the big slog across the line. Ends up getting a big inside edge onto his front pad and the ball lobs in the air right next to him. Cummins sees this, runs and tries to catch it, but it falls short of him.
Fires it right up there, Rohit can only drive it to the man at mid off.
Pushes it behind square on the off side, past point and scurries across to complete the run.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Rahane moves across the line and works it towards mid on.
Stays right behind the line of this one and blocks it out to end the over.
Outside off on a good length, dabbed straight to the point fielder.
Seaming into the batsman, he looks to play it across the line but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Fuller ball, outside the line of off stump, Rohit prods forward and offers a solid bat in defense.
Strays on the pads a bit, nudged just wide of the mid-wicket fielder for one.
Fullish in length targeting the off stick, Ajinkya gets inside the line and works it away on the on side.
On the shorter side of things, pushed into the off side from the back foot.
Good length delivery in the off stump channel, Rohit attempts a tap and run in front of cover-point but the fielder there is too quick to get to it.
Very full from Cummins, Rohit flicks it but can't find the gap. Steven Smith at mid-wicket cuts it off quickly.
Just back of a length again, on middle and leg, it's worked in front of square leg for a brisk single.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed to backward point from within the crease.

FOUR! That's an excellent shot! Full and right there to be hit, Rahane doesn't miss out as he presents the full face of the bat to this. Drives it sweetly straight back down and finds the fence with ease. Super shot.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, Rohit turns it to the right of the mid-wicket fielder.
Fraction straighter in line, played back down the track after getting squared up a bit.

Almost had the edge there. Pretty close. Coulter-Nile with a good length delivery on the fifth stump line, Sharma has a feel for it and almost nicks it behind. There was a hint of away movement which almost did the trick.
Short of a good length, easily opens the bat face and runs it down to third man for a single.
On a good length around off, straightening up a shade, Rahane taps it down on the off side with soft hands.
Starts off with a full ball swinging away from around off, Rahane drives it straight back to the bowler.
Nathan Coulter-Nile will bowl with the second new ball. Just the lone slip in position.
Fuller in length and on middle, Rohit once again is behind the line as he blocks it towards mid on.
Angles in a full ball just around off, Rohit gets behind the line, only is half-forward but defends it safely.
Good length delivery outside off, this time Rahane stays back to run it down towards third man for a single.
FOUR! A very good shot to get off the mark! Full in length again, on middle this time, Rahane picks it off his pads and flicks it sweetly through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full in length around off, 142 kph, Rahane is on the front foot in defense.

Shout for an lbw! Not given by the umpire. Cummins hurls across a length ball around middle, angling in with extra bounce. Rahane fails to defend it from the crease and is hit on the front pad. They put in an unsuccessful appeal. Warner from mid off signals that it's high. The Hawk Eye confirms the same.
Back for the chase! Ajinkya Rahane and Rohit Sharma are the opening pair for India. Pat Cummins to bowl with the first new ball. A slip in place. All set, here we go...
